sources.details: Four confidences sum 3, mean 3/4=.75, correct 2/4=.5, one bin ECE=.25. Added .25-correct sample has error .75 with weight1/5; high-bin .25 weight4/5 =>.35. NLL -ln(.8)=.2231435513, -ln(.2)=1.6094379124. Unhalved Brier .8^2+(.2-1)^2=1.28. ECE takes absolute difference within bins before weighting; global signed difference permits cancellation. Figure point and percentage lengths derived in reviewer-receipts.json; no model result invented.

claims.statement: A shared positive temperature divides logits before candidate-axis softmax. T=1 preserves original probabilities; smaller T sharpens unequal scores, larger T softens, and score/argmax ordering remains unchanged. Fit T on validation then fix it before test; this transforms confidence rather than adding classifier knowledge and does not guarantee test improvement.
